'''''Betula celtiberica''''', the '''Iberian white birch''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Betulaceae]], native to Great Britain, northwestern Spain and Portugal.<ref>https://flora-on.pt/#/1betula+celtiberica</ref><ref name="POWO_107737-1" >{{cite POWO |id=107737-1 |title=''Betula celtiberica'' Rothm. & Vasc. |access-date=9 April 2023 }}</ref> In Spain is it often found on north-facing valley slopes, forming mixed [[Mesic habitat|mesic]] forests with the common beech ''[[Fagus sylvatica]]''.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1556/ComEc.15.2014.2.3 |title=Drivers of herb-layer species diversity in two unmanaged temperate forests in northern Spain |year=2014 |last1=Sabatini |first1=F. |last2=Jiménez-Alfaro |first2=B. |last3=Burrascano |first3=S. |last4=Blasi |first4=C. |journal=Community Ecology |volume=15 |issue=2 |pages=147–157 |bibcode=2014ComEc..15..147S }}</ref>
